name: raycast-aws
title: AWS (Granted)
description: Open the AWS Console or a CLI session for an AWS profile managed by Granted/assume.
author: rjmsilveira

commands.name: open-console
commands.title: AWS Console
commands.subtitle: AWS (Granted)
commands.description: Pick an AWS profile and open it in the AWS web console

commands.name: open-cli
commands.title: AWS CLI
commands.subtitle: AWS (Granted)
commands.description: Pick an AWS profile and open a terminal session with it assumed

commands.name: sso-login
commands.title: AWS SSO Login
commands.subtitle: AWS (Granted)
commands.description: Log in via AWS SSO, pre-filled with your last-used region and start URL

commands.name: sso-populate
commands.title: AWS SSO Populate Profiles
commands.subtitle: AWS (Granted)
commands.description: Generate/update ~/.aws/config profiles from AWS SSO, with a choice of profile name templates

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal Application
preferences.description: The terminal app used to open an assumed CLI session
